text:
maya: Heads-up — getting reports that the billing tiles in Console show $0 or NaN for a handful of orgs this morning. Seen in US & EU clusters. cc @alex @jon

alex: Thanks, Maya. Can you drop a couple example org_ids and a screenshot? Are these all on Dedicated or hosted?

maya: orgs: org_7721, org_993, org_44. Mix of hosted and a Dedicated POC. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/xyz (image attached). Appears only on the Token Cost dashboard; other billing pages look normal.

jon: I pulled a quick query against billing.events — totals look sane. Suspect the dashboard aggregation or the metrics pipeline that powers the tiles.

devin: Which metric feeds the tiles? Is it the cost_by_token materialized view or the metrics-service aggregated counters?

elise: It's the metrics-service -> pre-agg job -> billing-tiles topic -> Console. If the pre-agg emits null for unit_cost we show NaN downstream.

maya: Repro steps from support: 1) Login to console as admin for org_7721 2) Navigate to Analytics > Token cost 3) Note $0 / NaN for current month 4) Click token breakdown — shows empty chart.

alex: Can someone grep the metrics-service logs for the org IDs around 2026-03-17 08:00-09:00 UTC? I want to see if aggregation emitted nulls.

devin: On it. Quick log excerpt I found:

```
2026-03-17T08:12:03Z WARN metrics-preagg - org=org_7721 - total_tokens=0 - avg_unit_cost=null - reason=divide_by_zero
2026-03-17T08:12:03Z DEBUG billing-producer - publishing billing_tile org=org_7721 payload={"token_cost":null}
```

alex: That divide_by_zero suggests the pre-agg didn't guard against zero tokens. We used to default avg_unit_cost=0.000001 in 2024 patch; looks like regression.

jon: Confirmed similar lines for org_993 and org_44. That explains NaN. But why only a subset of orgs? Maybe they have zero billable tokens this window which hits new logic path.

elise: I can push a hotfix to metrics-preagg to coalesce nulls to 0.0001 and add a safe-guard: if total_tokens == 0 then unit_cost = 0. Also I'll add a unit test. Planning deploy in ~20m if approved.

maya: Support update for customers: "We're aware of an issue causing the Token Cost dashboard to display $0/NaN for some orgs. Engineers are rolling a fix; metrics themselves are not lost and billing is accurate. We'll follow up when tiles are backfilled."

alex: +1 to quick fix. Also we should backfill the billing-tiles topic for affected orgs after deploy. I'll run a targeted backfill job for the 3 orgs and the last 7 days once the fix is live.

devin: Backfill plan: run `scripts/backfill_billing_tiles --org org_7721 --start 2026-03-10 --end 2026-03-17` in staging, validate, then prod. It takes ~3-5m per org.

billing-bot: Incident draft created: INC-2026-1033 — Token tile NaN/$0 for subset of orgs. Owner: elise. Priority: P2.

maya: Elise, can you include the runbook section to verify: 1) check metrics-service logs for null emissions 2) confirm pre-agg deploy success 3) run targeted backfill 4) verify Console shows non-NaN values and chart renders.

elise: Yep. Posting PR: https://github.com/redwood/metrics-service/pull/284 — adds null-coalescing and test. Will deploy to prod lane alpha after CI.

jon: After backfill, we should add a dashboard alert if billing tiles emit nulls for >1 org in a 1h window. Prefer to catch regression early.

alex: Good call. I'll add a Grafana alert: query for count(billing_tile_messages where token_cost is null) > 1 in last 1h.

maya: Support note updated: customers notified individually with ETA ~30-60m for fix + backfill.

elise: Deployed hotfix to alpha, smoke good. Deploying to prod lane now.

devin: Backfill started for org_7721 (job id bf-7721-17685).

billing-bot: INC-2026-1033 status update: hotfix deployed, backfills queued.

elise: Prod deploy finished at 08:28 UTC. Unit test added. Patching pre-agg to set unit_cost = 0 when total_tokens == 0.

jon: Verified prod metrics-service logs show no more null emits.

devin: Backfills finished for org_7721 and org_993. org_44 queued (quota throttle), expected complete in 10m.

maya: Verified with customers — dashboards now show $0.00 (expected for zero usage) instead of NaN, and historical tiles backfilled. Closing loop.

alex: Follow-ups: 1) postmortem to eng-infra with RCA (regression from 2025 refactor), 2) add Grafana alert, 3) add unit test coverage for zero-token path, 4) run a sweep to find other pre-agg places that could emit nulls.

maya: Thanks team. Marking as resolved on support side.

billing-bot: INC-2026-1033 resolved by elise.

elise: I'll file the formal postmortem doc and link it here when ready.
